messages:
rachel_sales: Quick thread for Medica POC. They need: redacted SOC2 summary, ISO scope, pen-test attestation naming Medica, and an EU private UAT (7-10 days). Can we confirm shareables + pricing?

mark_se: For the UAT we can do temporary VPN (mTLS) or VPC peering. SAML not required for initial run; ephemeral creds OK. Will provide a short staging diagram.

priya_compliance: We can share a redacted SOC2 Type II exec summary and ISO27001 scope. Pen-test attestation ok but must be high-level (no exploit PoCs). Full report requires NDA + legal review. Also require evidence-handling attestation signed by Medica before transfer.

client_sam: Procurement: "Please include legal signatory name, CVE IDs if possible, and a line-item quote for EU node + VPN setup."

anna_legal: Signatory: Anna Park, General Counsel. I can sign the attestation within 48 hours after draft approval. If they request the full report we will need an NDA and ~7 business days for review.

billing_bot: Quote snippet: EU temporary node (10d pro-rated) = $2,000 one-time. VPN (mTLS) setup = $1,200 one-time. Presigned S3 transfer (7d expiry) recommended.

mark_se: Redaction rules confirmed: remove customer PII, internal IP ranges, full logs. CVE IDs ok if public. We'll prepare a presigned S3 bundle (7d). Ephemeral API keys auto-expire after 14 days. Example call:
```bash
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer UAT_KEY\" https://eu.api.redwood.ai/v1/ping
```

priya_compliance: Action items:
1) Prepare redacted evidence pack + pen-test attestation (include public CVE IDs only) by 2024-12-08.
2) Legal to sign final attestation within 48h after draft (Anna).
3) Billing to send formal amendment with line items by EOD.
4) SE to provide staging diagram + presigned S3 plan.

rachel_sales: Thanks all, I'll email Medica with the timeline and attach the charging amendment once billing posts it. :white_check_mark:

client_sam: Thanks team. We'll review attestation draft and confirm on VPN vs peering by EOD.
